stepTitle: As blood passes through the capillary bed in an organ, the capillaries join to form venules (small veins). If the blood speed increases by a factor of $$4.00$$ and the total cross-sectional area of the venules is $$10.0\,\text{cm}**2,$$ what is the total cross-sectional area of the capillaries feeding these venules (in $$\text{cm}**2)$$?
